# Notes — full bench-v1 val 2026-10-18 (real-GPU, RTX 4050 Laptop 6 GB, llama.cpp b11139-42916d83f CUDA 12.4)

**bench-v1 is SYNTHETIC** (generated by V2 `benchmark/make_dataset.py`), not real CVs. The test split is not in
this repo and was not used.

- All 202 val requirements (45 cases), arms base_k (scale 0) and lora_k (scale 1), prompt matcher-v1,
  BM25-ESCO k=3, constrained decoding with `services/matcher/schema.json`, decoding as in `config.json`.
- Command: `.venv\Scripts\python scripts\smoke_matcher.py --n 0 --arms base_k,lora_k --schema services\matcher\schema.json --out eval\results\2026-10-18_val_full`
- Run log: `run.log`. Per-item outputs: `base_k.jsonl`, `lora_k.jsonl`. Metrics: `summary.json` / `summary.md`
  (per-class F1 and confusion matrix included).
- Determinism check: the 30 items of `../2026-10-18_schema_check/` have identical raw output in this run (30/30 both arms).
- Accuracy / F1 use the model's own decision; there is no deterministic validator yet (no quote check, no
  not_documented -> review rule). "verbatim quotes" = quotes that are exact substrings of the CV text.
- False MET (pred MET, gold not MET), the most harmful error:
  - base_k 4: val-006 r1, val-009 r3, val-014 r2, val-016 r1
  - lora_k 6: val-006 r1, val-009 r3, val-016 r1, val-017 r1, val-028 r4, val-029 r4
- V2 records LoRA val macro-F1 0.908 without a full prediction file (T02b report); our 0.892 has a full,
  traceable file. Not the same setup (V2 llama-cpp-python, no schema), so not a replication.
